title: Scalar function called once per order line inside SUM
prompt: Product revenue report for one quarter (about 1.1M orders and 4.4M order lines). Runtime about 4 minutes, almost all
of it CPU in a serial plan. qe.fn_NetLineAmount is called once per line: 4.4M calls. The function could be inlined
(sys.sql_modules.is_inlineable = 1), but the database-scoped configuration TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING is OFF after an
earlier incident and the owner will not turn it on this quarter. Finance reconciles NetAmount to the cent with the
invoice system, which rounds each line to two decimals before it adds them. The function is in the schema file.
data_notes: Azure SQL Database, General Purpose Gen5, 8 vCores, compatibility level 160. READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON. Query Store READ_WRITE. Collation SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS. All foreign keys are trusted. Statistics: auto create and auto update ON; a nightly job updates Orders, OrderLines and Payments with FULLSCAN.
OrderLines: 120M rows, 4 per order on average. About 0.3% of orders have no lines.

Orders: 30M rows, 2016 to now, ~12k per day now. The 25 partner customers own ~9M orders (30%), up to 1.2M each. Other customers average ~10 orders (max ~400). The density estimate for CustomerID is ~15 rows. Status: Shipped 83.8%, Cancelled 7%, Paid 6%, Returned 3%, Pending 0.2% (~60k rows, all from the last 72 hours). SalesChannel: Web 62%, Store 20%, Partner 12%, Phone 6%. PromoCode is NULL for 85%. ShipRegionID is NULL for Store pickups (~20%). OrderDate is datetime2(7); Partner and Store imports stamp one timestamp on a whole batch, so many orders of one customer share an OrderDate.
baseline_sql: JOIN qe.Orders o ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID

correct_families.description: Write the function's expression in the query and round each line to decimal(19,2) before SUM, as the function's return type does.
reference_sql: SUM(CAST(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount) AS decimal(19,2))) AS NetAmount
JOIN qe.Orders o ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID

traps.why: The function returns decimal(19,2), so each line is rounded before the sum. A sum of unrounded lines differs by fractions of a cent per line and by whole cents per product.
traps.told_apart_by: Two lines of one product at 0.3350 each: rounded per line they sum to 0.68, unrounded to 0.67.
example_sql: JOIN qe.Orders o ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID

traps.why: Rounding the total is not rounding each line.
traps.told_apart_by: Two lines of one product at 0.3350 each: rounded per line they sum to 0.68, rounded after the sum to 0.67.
example_sql: CAST(SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS decimal(19,2)) AS NetAmount
JOIN qe.Orders o ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID

traps.why: The owner has ruled out the database-wide setting this quarter. It changes the plan of every query that calls a scalar function.
traps.example_sql: ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET TSQL_SCALAR_UDF_INLINING = ON;

traps.why: Any form that still calls the function runs it once per line in a serial plan.
example_sql: CROSS APPLY (SELECT qe.fn_NetLineAmount(ol.Quantity, ol.UnitPrice, ol.Discount) AS Net) x
JOIN qe.Orders o ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID

min_improvement.basis: 4.4M function calls in a serial plan are the 4 minutes. The inline expression runs in a parallel batch-mode plan.
